name: has_high_qs_ranking_education
description: Founder has at least one education with QS ranking <= 50
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 50 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: industry_tech_or_health
description: Founder industry is in the technology or healthcare sectors
expression: lambda founder: founder.get('industry', '').lower() in ['software development', 'medical equipment manufacturing', 'clinical & diagnostic healthcare', 'biotechnology & nanotechnology research']

name: has_executive_role
description: Founder has held an executive role (e.g., CEO, President, VP)
expression: lambda founder: any(e.get('role', '').lower() in ['ceo', 'president', 'vp', 'cmo', 'coo', 'director'] for e in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_investment_event
description: Founder has participated in an IPO or acquisition

name: industry_is_nan
description: Founder industry is missing or NaN
expression: lambda founder: founder.get('industry', None) is None or founder.get('industry', '').lower() == 'nan'

name: has_dominant_degree_field
description: Founder has a degree in a leading QS-ranked field
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 10 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: long_term_experience
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_duration(e.get('duration', '')) > 9 for e in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: small_company_experience
description: Founder worked at companies with <= 50 employees
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_company_size(e.get('company_size', '')) <= 50 for e in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: multiple_educations
description: Founder has more than one education

name: industry_experience_in_target
description: Founder has industry experience in target sectors (e.g., tech, health, finance)
expression: lambda founder: any(e.get('industry', '').lower() in ['software development', 'healthcare', 'financial services'] for e in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: recent_role
description: Founder held a role within last 3 years
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_duration(e.get('duration', '')) <= 3 for e in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_education_in_field
description: Founder has education in specific fields like 'Computer Science' or 'Engineering'
expression: lambda founder: any('computer' in e.get('field', '').lower() or 'engineering' in e.get('field', '').lower() for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: has_leadership_experience
description: Founder has held leadership roles (e.g., founder, board member)
expression: lambda founder: any(e.get('role', '').lower() in ['founder', 'board member', 'chairman'] for e in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_international_experience
description: Founder has worked in roles with international scope
expression: lambda founder: any('international' in e.get('role', '').lower() for e in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_high_company_size_experience
description: Founder has worked at companies with > 1000 employees
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_company_size(e.get('company_size', '')) > 1000 for e in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_multiple_exits
description: Founder has participated in multiple IPOs or acquisitions
